expansion_contract.SMA_allocation: Actual sample/state blocks own unique cycle IDs; union across campaign totals off=9,on=12; extra cycles are labeled authored extensions.
expansion_contract.modulus_allocation: Actual coupons own unique trial IDs; union per material and spacing totals three.
expansion_contract.required_prepared_part_ids: Cover branch required_preparation_roles with mandatory physical origin and receipt.
expansion_contract.component_identity_binding: Bill-of-materials component batches reference actual output IDs from part preparation, grouped by independently recorded current location.
expansion_contract.analysis_location: Data-service handoffs do not move samples or update last physical station.
expansion_contract.last_safe_station: Resolve from last independently recorded safe physical location, never latest analysis role.
